itemUsage.en: Leizi of the Tianshis of Yan, in partial recognition of the Dao of Rhodes Island, decides to continue her journey alongside you.
itemUsage.zh: 大炎天师惊蛰，部分认可了罗德岛之“道”，决定与你继续同行。

itemDesc.en: With a righteous heart, guide your thoughts and steel your will, for the road is yet long.
itemDesc.zh: 思以正心，心定则志坚，行道修远。

description.en:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands forward and to both sides</>; deals <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s1:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage to ground enemies in these three directions
<@ba.rem>Can store 3 charges, Trait effect will not reset until charges are fully depleted</>
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>朝前方和两侧扩大</>。对三个方向的地面敌人各造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s1:0%}</>的物理伤害\n<@ba.rem>可充能3次，充能耗尽前特性不重置</>

description.en: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands to all ground tiles up to 3 tiles away</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s2:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage to <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target_s2}</> target(s); every lightning strike during this skill gives ATK <@ba.vup>+{thunder_atk:0%}</> (stacks up to 25 times)

description.en: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>greatly increases</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s3:0%}</> of ATK as AoE Physical damage and generate electric currents at the target's position that travel <@ba.vup>three tiles</> in all four cardinal directions; currents will <@ba.vup>bounce back</> if they hit this unit or a High Ground tile; all enemies on a tile with a current take <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_current:0%}</> of Leizi the Thunderbringer's ATK as Arts damage every 0.6s, and have a <@ba.vup>{prob:0%}</> chance to be <$ba.tremble>Frightened</> for <@ba.vup>3s</>
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击间隔<@ba.vdown>大幅延长</>，攻击造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_s3:0%}</>的范围物理伤害，目标位置产生朝四周<@ba.vup>流动三格</>的电流。电流碰到自身或高台时<@ba.vup>反弹</>，电流所在地块上所有敌人每0.6秒受到司霆惊蛰攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_current:0%}</>的法术伤害，且有<@ba.vup>{prob:0%}</>概率<$ba.tremble>战栗</><@ba.vup>3秒</>

description.en:
Somewhere in a Tianshi Bureau workshop, Lin Qingyan stares at the blueprints, silent in thought.
'There's no arts device that you want to make?' her senior disciple finally asks.
'...When I mentioned wanting to go down the mountain for a travel, Master sent me here first, but he didn't specify what type of item I should make. At first I thought, 'Does he think I'm too impatient? Has he sent me to craft some intricate device to still my restlessness and temper my character?' But arts devices are ultimately just tools that people use. Whether I temper my character or not is my own decision. The question I should be asking is, 'What do I want?''
She examines the blueprints one by one. From swords to staves, each blueprint is a crystallization of the Tianshi Bureau's thousand years of wisdom, dazzling in its brilliance. To call any one of them 'useless' would be the height of arrogance. But which one is Lin Qingyan truly seeking in this moment?
Her gaze falls on a dusty pile of discarded scraps in the corner.
'It was originally a portable device preloaded with Originium Arts, and it fit well enough at the waist, but its performance was disappointing. Lin, you are already at the level where lightning answers your call. Making a special device to hold it is unnecessary, isn't it?'
A device that holds lightning...
Something stirs in her. She picks up a piece of scrap and examines it. After a moment's thought, she asks her senior disciple for the blueprint, sits down, and calmly begins assembling the abandoned device.
Several days later, Lin Qingyan bids her master farewell and prepares to set off down the mountain. A small coffer hangs at her waist, filled with sharp, crackling light. When her master asks her about it, she replies:
'As a child, I trained diligently so that heaven's lightning might split the darkness of the long night. But now, I've learned that there are rights and there are wrongs on this land. There are laws, and there are human emotions. Lightning might answer my call, yet there are times when it is forbidden, times when it ought not come, and times when it may come but need not. Judgment of right and wrong lies in a single human thought. So I keep this coffer to store the lightning that is summoned in those moments, so that it may spark self-reflection.'
With that, she bows deeply and starts down the mountain.
description.zh:
天师府的工坊内，麟青砚望着图纸沉思不语。
“没有你想做的法器？”师姐忍不住问。
“……我提起要下山游历时，师父便让我先来这里，却并不指定我做哪一样。我先是觉得，师父是否觉得我太毛躁，要我挑一样复杂的法器来磨砺心性，但想来，法器不过是人用的物件，修心也是我自己的决定，我该问的，是自己要什么。”
她一样一样查看图纸。从剑到杖，天师府千年智慧的结晶，何等璀璨，要说哪一样是用不上的，未免太过自大。但哪一样是如今的麟青砚想要的？
她的目光落在角落里一堆积灰的废料上。
“那本是个便携式的源石技艺预置装置，佩戴在腰间倒是正好，作用却不尽如人意。到了麟师妹你的程度，雷霆早已是招之即来，专门弄个装置来装，不是多此一举？”
可将雷霆存于其中……
麟青砚似被触动，反而拾起一块废料来端详。思忖片刻，问师姐要了图纸来，坐下来定心安装这被废弃的法器。
数日后，麟青砚向师告辞，预备下山游历。其腰间挂着一只匣子，内有电光凌厉。师问其由，答：
“儿时修炼勤勉，只为天雷昭昭，曜其长夜。如今却感，世间许多是非曲直，有法理亦有人情，雷霆虽可呼之即来，亦有不可来、不该来，或可来可不来之时。是非判断，皆由人之一念。故以此匣，将当下未发之雷存于其中，以时时自省。”
说罢，长揖作辞，下山去了。
